samples.label: ZW-60%
samples.notes: 原文也写作 ZW-60。60% 两性离子基团（磺烷基化的哌啶鎓）、40% 哌啶鎓。传导类型记成两性是 Claude 的归类，待 Kai 定稿（D-81）

samples.label: ZW-0%
samples.notes: 原文也写作 ZW-0。不含两性离子基团、只有哌啶鎓的同系列膜，记成同文对照；传导类型记成阴离子交换是 Claude 的归类，待 Kai 定稿（D-81）

locator.text: 第 4 页，2.3 节，第 1 句

evidence.snippet:
A series of zwitterionic poly(terphenylene piperidinium)s were pre­
pared in superacid-mediated Friedel-Crafts type co-polycondensations
of p-terphenyl and a mixture of Pip and zwPip at a controlled ratio.
evidence.internal_note: 判断理由：聚合物由对三联苯和 N-甲基-4-哌啶酮（及其磺丁基化的两性离子单体 zwPip）缩聚得到，主链是聚（三联苯哌啶鎓），侧链是磺丁基，结构里没有含氟的单元；三氟甲磺酸、三氟乙酸只是缩聚用的酸，不进入聚合物；膜由共聚物的 DMSO 溶液直接浇铸，没有增强层和共混组分。样品名在这一句后面两句（ZW-40%、ZW-50%、ZW-60%），抄不进同一句。摘要里原文自己也称 non-fluorinated。

evidence.summary: 把膜浸在 1.6 mol/L 五价钒（VO2+）、2 mol/L 硫酸的溶液里，室温下放了 400 小时以上；浸泡后的核磁共振氢谱和原始样品相比没有特定的变化，原文据此认为聚合物主链和离子基团在这个条件下稳定。

stability_method.reported: immersing small pieces of membranes in 10 mL of 1.6 M VO2+ in 2 M H2SO4 solution at room temperature for more than 400 h; 1H NMR spectra of immersed and pristine membranes were compared

evidence.conditions_snippet:
The chemical stability of the different membranes was evaluated by
immersing small pieces of membranes in 10 mL of 1.6 M VO+
2 in 2 M
H2SO4 solution at room temperature for more than 400 h. To investigate
any structural changes in the polymers, 1H NMR spectra of immersed
and pristine membranes were compared.

evidence.internal_note: 这一句说的是 the membranes，没有点样品名；记在 ZW-60% 名下的依据是第 8 页图 5 的题注（1H NMR spectra of ZW-60%: (a) initial sample, (b) after the exposure to the oxidative solution）。别的膜的谱图在补充材料图 S4，不在手上，没有另记。来源文本里五价钒写成“VO+ 2”（上下标打散），就是 VO2+。

evidence.conditions_snippet:
The
anolyte was under continuous nitrogen flow and the cell was galva­
nostatically charged-discharged at 130 mA cm− 2 for 50 cycles at room
temperature using an 8-channel battery test system CT2001A (Landt
Instruments) in the four-wire configuration. To avoid damage to the
electrodes, and to preserve the stability of the electrolyte, the upper and
lower limit of cut-off voltages was set at 1.7 V and 0.8 V

locator.text: 第 7 页，3.2.2 节，“Comparing the efficiencies in Fig. 3d”一句

evidence.snippet:
terionic membranes showed CE over 97%, which was higher than the
system based on N212 (approx. 95%).
evidence.internal_note: 这是 130 mA cm-2 下 50 圈循环测试（图 3d）的库仑效率，原文没有说是哪一圈还是平均；同一个样品这项指标只有这一条，没有记 cycle_index。图 3d 上 N212 的库仑效率大约在 95% 上下，和正文对得上。流速原文两处不一致：实验部分写 20 mL min-1，图 3、图 4 的题注写 40 mL min-1，所以 flow_rate 只写了 reported、没有写 value。温度实验部分写 room temperature，题注写 24 °C，value 取题注的 24。

method.reported: Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) ... four-probe ... high-frequency resistance of the membranes was obtained from the difference of Rw and Rwo (resistances with and without membrane); ASR = (Rw − Rwo)A

conditions_locator.text: 第 5 页，2.5.5 节讲阻抗谱的一段；测试溶液另见第 6 页图 3 题注（ASR of different membranes using 2 M H2SO4 electrolyte）

evidence.conditions_snippet:
Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) was employed to
measure the resistivity of the membranes using a four-probe VersaSTAT
4 workstation in a frequency range of 106 Hz–10 Hz with an amplitude
perturbation wave of 5 mV. The membranes were soaked in 2 M H2SO4
solution for 24 h before assembling the membrane in the flow cell set-up
(Fuel Cell Technologies (FCT)). The measurements were conducted at
room temperature and the high-frequency resistance of the membranes
was obtained from the difference of Rw and Rwo (resistances with and
without membrane, respectively).

evidence.internal_note: 柱顶约在第 379 到 380 行。正文没有给任何一张膜的面电阻数值，没法用正文的数校验量法；只用纵轴 0.2、0.4、0.6、0.8 四个刻度核对过，线性关系对得上。纵轴最小刻度间隔 0.1，按规定取到三位有效数字。测量方向原文没有明说（在液流电池夹具里测，面积用膜的有效截面 5 cm2），所以 direction 写未报告。
